vectors.name: b1-v4-vault-wit-roundtrip
vectors.description: shell-stub.render-panel calls vault::put-receipt and vault::get-receipt through the WIT host-import binding surface. The host stub (in-memory HashMap) stores bytes and returns them. The guest encodes the OID and a round-trip marker in the payload. The harness asserts: (a) payload contains 'rt=ok' (guest confirmed round-trip), (b) host vault snapshot contains the probe bytes at the OID from the payload. This proves the WIT guest<->host binding wiring is live, not just that instantiation succeeds.

vectors.name: b1-v5-determinism
vectors.description: Two INDEPENDENT invocations of render-panel on two independent Wasmtime Engine+Store+Component instances, with identical inputs, produce byte-identical output payloads (SHA-256 hashes are identical). This validates the WASM 3.0 Deterministic Profile invariant. Signed execution receipts depend on this: both sender and receiver must derive the same receipt OID from the same bytecode + same inputs.
